assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: an independent transparent decorative bitmap cutout for an engineering portfolio hero
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background; no backdrop or floor plane. Preserve clean transparency through holes and between separated parts of the subject.
Style/medium: tactile, realistic industrial catalogue product photography, refined and physically plausible.
Composition/framing: exactly one subject, centred and fully visible in a square canvas, generous clear margin, slight three-quarter product-photography angle.
Lighting/mood: soft studio lighting, natural material highlights, a subtle soft natural contact shadow only, with the shadow remaining translucent.
Color palette: natural steel, aluminium, black rubber and muted brass as appropriate. This cutout will float around editorial type on warm ivory #F4F0E6, muted indigo #334E68 and restrained vermilion #C45A3D; do not paint a background with those colours.
Constraints: generic decorative mechanical component, no claimed connection to any person's project or prototype. No text, labels, logos, watermarks, backdrop, grid, additional objects, neon, glossy chrome sci-fi styling, excessive reflections, or cropped edges.
Primary request: one precision ball bearing with brushed steel inner and outer rings and a clearly visible open ball race.
Subject/materials: an unsealed precision radial ball bearing; distinct polished steel balls visible around the inner race, brushed machined steel rings with fine circular tooling texture, an open centre bore. Clear realistic ring and ball geometry.
assets.visual_inspection: Visually verified: full bearing, brushed rings, distinct visible steel balls and brass cage, transparent centre bore, no text or extra objects.
